text: じょしゅに　ダウジングマシンを　もたせたぞ！

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: This verb ending means making or letting someone do the action; the person who does it gets に. じょしゅに　もたせた = 'I had my aide carry it'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, hearty way of announcing something, used mostly by men. もたせたぞ = 'I've had him carry it, you hear!'.
